elements.element: Commercial general liability USD 1M per occurrence
elements.evidence: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence
professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000

elements.element: Cyber/privacy USD 5M where Vendor processes Customer Data
elements.evidence: cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 covering TrueLink's hosting of the Web Site and processing of Client Content and other Client data

elements.element: Workers' compensation as required by law
elements.evidence: workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law
provide Client with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request
errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000
cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000

reasons: All six preferred atomic elements (CGL per-occurrence and aggregate, E&O 2M, cyber 5M tied to data processing, statutory workers' comp, certificates on request) are expressly stated in the inserted clause.
The rule expected an insurance clause and none existed; a single concise inserted covenant is the minimal remedy, and the untouched force majeure paragraph is unchanged.
Ancillary phrases ('at its own expense', 'throughout the term of this Agreement') supply cost allocation and duration necessary to make the covenant operative and are not surplus.
No contradiction or dangling mechanic introduced; references to Client, Web Site and Client Content align with existing agreement terminology.
